content:
Factor \(836=(a-2)(b-2)(c-2)\). Since \(a,b,c>4\), the factors must all be \(>2\):

\[
836=4\cdot 11\cdot 19.
\]

Thus

\[
(a-2,b-2,c-2)=(4,11,19)
\]

in some order.

Cubes with no more than four neighbors are the 8 corner cubes plus the non-corner edge cubes:

\[
8 + 4[(a-2)+(b-2)+(c-2)]
= 8 + 4(4+11+19)
= 8 + 136
= 144.
\]

\boxed{144}
